$comment: RFC 0173 §B — durable delivery binds with webhooks; no durable flag; retryPolicy is the v2 carrier of the delivery obligation (was triggerBridge.retryPolicy at v1)

signatureAlgorithms.description: RFC 0201 §A.3 — `v1` MUST be listed (schema-enforced by `contains`); `standard-webhooks-1` names the Standard Webhooks 1.0.0 companion scheme a subscriber opts into per subscription at registerWebhook.

retryPolicy.description: spec/v2/core/webhooks.md §Delivery — the policy a host retries a failed attempt under. The webhooks family carries it at v2; `triggerBridge.retryPolicy` is the v1 carrier and stays through the overlap.

deadLetter.description: RFC 0188 §A.5 — the DELIVERY dead-letter sink, advertised only by a host that serves `GET /webhooks/{webhookId}/dead-letters`. **Distinct from the top-level `deadLetter` FAMILY (RFC 0053), which is the RUN sink** and whose own `retentionDays` governs a dead-lettered run's fork-eligibility window. Three documents previously routed delivery dead-letters to RFC 0053, which is run-scoped and says so twice; this facet is where the delivery sink actually lives.

retentionDays.description: How long a dead-lettered delivery stays readable. Observable: a record's `expiresAt − deadLetteredAt` matches it.

maxPageSize.description: Ceiling the host clamps `limit` to (RFC 0182 §A.3 page-ceiling idiom).

secretRotation.description: RFC 0201 §E — zero-downtime rotation for subscriptions opted into `standard-webhooks-1`; advertised only by a host serving `rotateWebhookSecret` (`POST /webhooks/{webhookId}/rotate-secret`). A host that does not advertise it answers that route `404 not_found`.

overlapSeconds.description: How long after a rotation `webhook-signature` carries an entry under the previous secret beside the new one; `previousSecretExpiresAt = rotatedAt + overlapSeconds`.
